text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug (CDT, UTC-5). You posted it here in #inc-vtg-hartford: both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan.

The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard from that report until the kiosks came back. Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07 AM, so the manual workaround ran for about 25 minutes.

Mateo noted six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44 AM. The channel doesn't show when you first noticed the outage, so 10:42 is only the time of your first post. The status-page access problem was tracked separately under INC-4821.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: Ruth, the screenshot is attached to ticket INC-4821. Gideon said so in this channel on 3 Aug at 11:08 AM, when he was still chasing the status-page access problem. Mateo's account got "access denied" on the status page, though his admin account could open Pemberline Dock.
